claims.claim_text: Millions of U.S. workers will continue to hold low-paid jobs that may not require substantial education or skills even as the economy changes and grows.
Many U.S. low-wage workers are women, people of color or recent immigrants.
Low-wage workers provide valuable services to U.S. society, and their work has dignity.
Commitment to ensure that U.S. low-wage workers receive the same dignity, respect and fairness at work as workers in more highly skilled and better-paid jobs.
Support for fair treatment of temporary, part-time and contract workers, including the wages and benefits appropriate to the work they perform.
